title: Superhuman feature tile
description: A 12px-radius colour tile: a small eyebrow and a 25px headline at the bottom-left, a media slot beside it (or above it) bleeding off the edge. Six surfaces: teal, maroon, indigo, purple, stone and pale lilac. On phones the text sits on top and the media below.
notes: teal, maroon, indigo and purple are deep surfaces (chart-1…4) with light text; stone and lilac are light
give height at desktop through className (e.g. lg:h-[16.25rem]); phones size by content
media is a ReactNode; empty shows a placeholder
name: superhuman-tile

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: the small label above the headline

props.name: media
props.description: the image or screenshot; empty shows a placeholder

props.name: layout
props.description: side: text left, media right (phones: text then media) · stack: media above, text below at every width

props.name: overlay
props.description: phones only (stack layout): the media fills the whole tile behind the text instead of sitting above it, so the tile stays short

props.name: inset
props.description: pad the media from the top and left so a window sits inside the tile instead of bleeding in

props.name: mediaWidth
props.description: width of the media area at desktop when layout is side (a Tailwind width class)

props.name: className
props.description: height and grid placement at desktop
